connector.name: Govtoolspro MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Workflow tools for federal contractors: go/no-go scoring, incumbent intel, recompete, NECO.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package govtoolspro-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the smythmyke account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GOVTOOLSPRO_API_KEY
env.description: API key from the GovToolsPro extension → Profile → API Keys tab. Format: gtp_live_... or gtp_test_...

env.name: GOVTOOLSPRO_API_BASE
env.description: Override the API base URL. Default: https://mcp.govtoolspro.com/api/v1/workflows
